fields.title: Obstetrics (childbirth)
fields.bodyHtml:
Obstetrics in Israel: advanced methods and technologies

Israel is known for its achievements in medicine, obstetrics among them. Innovative technologies and methods of managing pregnancy and childbirth are used here, which ensures a high level of safety and health for both mother and baby.

Diagnosis and management of pregnancy:

  1. Prenatal diagnosis:
    • Ultrasound examination:
      Regular scans at various stages of pregnancy to monitor the development of the baby.
    • Non-invasive prenatal testing (NIPT):
      A blood test for the mother to detect genetic abnormalities in the baby at an early stage.
    • Amniocentesis and chorionic villus sampling:
      Carried out to obtain foetal cells for genetic analysis where there is a high risk of inherited disease.
  2. Specialist consultations:
    • Consultations with a geneticist, endocrinologist or cardiologist:
      In cases of high risk or where chronic conditions are present.
    • Psychological support and nutritional advice:
      To provide complete care for the mother's health.

Childbirth in Israel:

  1. Natural birth and birth with minimal intervention:
    • Professional support from a midwife and the option of natural methods of pain relief.
  2. Caesarean section:
    • Carried out for medical reasons or at the mother's request, using modern methods and equipment to minimise risk and speed recovery.
  3. Birth with analgesia:
    • Epidural analgesia: widely used to relieve pain during labour, allowing the mother to remain active and in control of the process.

Care after birth:

  • Neonatal screening: testing the newborn for metabolic, hormonal and genetic conditions.
  • Breastfeeding support: consultations with lactation specialists to help breastfeeding succeed.
  • Postnatal rehabilitation: recovery programmes for mothers after birth, including physiotherapy and psychological support.

Advantages of giving birth in Israel:

  • Highly qualified medical staff: obstetricians and gynaecologists in Israel have international experience and access to advanced research.
  • An individual approach: every pregnancy and birth is treated as unique, with an emphasis on the woman's individual needs and preferences.
  • Modern equipment: ensures accurate diagnosis and safety during birth.

The management of pregnancy and childbirth in Israel aims to provide the greatest possible comfort, safety and health for mother and baby alike, using the most modern medical practices and technologies.

fields.title: Coronary artery bypass grafting
fields.bodyHtml:
Introduction

Coronary artery disease is one of the most common cardiovascular conditions. It arises when the coronary arteries that supply blood to the heart muscle become narrowed or blocked. An inadequate blood supply can lead to stable angina or even to acute coronary syndrome. In this article we describe the methods of diagnosis and treatment and the advantages of coronary artery bypass grafting, particularly in the context of treatment in Israel.

Methods of diagnosis

Diagnosing coronary artery disease involves a range of methods that establish the extent of damage to the coronary arteries and allow the best treatment plan to be chosen. The main methods include:

  • Electrocardiography (ECG): a non-invasive method that records the electrical activity of the heart. An ECG can reveal abnormalities of heart rhythm and signs of ischaemia.
  • Stress testing: doctors carry out tests using physical exercise or pharmacological agents (dobutamine, for example) to assess the heart's response to stress and detect ischaemia.
  • Coronary angiography: an invasive method in which a contrast medium is introduced into the coronary arteries, allowing doctors to establish precisely where and how severely they are narrowed or blocked.

Methods of treatment

Treatment of coronary artery disease aims to restore a normal blood supply to the heart and prevent complications. One of the most effective treatments is coronary artery bypass grafting. The method involves the following stages:

  • Creating the grafts: during the operation the surgeon creates bypass routes, known as grafts, which go around the narrowed or blocked sections of the coronary arteries. The grafts may be made from the patient's own vessels (usually a vein from the leg) or from artificial materials.
  • Preparing for surgery: before the operation the patient undergoes thorough preparation, including assessment of general health and all necessary tests and diagnostic investigations.
  • The operation: during surgery the surgeons carry out the bypass grafting, creating the grafts and restoring a normal blood supply to the heart muscle.
  • Recovery: after the operation the patient goes through rehabilitation and a period of recovery, including monitoring of the heart rhythm, adjustment to a new way of life and advice on changes to diet and physical activity.

Advantages of treatment in Israel

Israel is a world leader in cardiac surgery and in the treatment of coronary artery disease. The advantages of coronary artery bypass grafting in Israel include:

  • Experience and expertise: cardiac surgeons at Israeli clinics have extensive experience and exceptional expertise, which ensures good surgical results.
  • Use of advanced technology: medical institutions in Israel are equipped with advanced technologies and innovative equipment for accurate diagnosis and successful surgery.
  • An individual approach: doctors in Israel take an individual approach to every patient, taking account of his or her particular circumstances and needs.

Conclusion

Coronary artery bypass grafting is an innovative and effective treatment for coronary artery disease that restores a normal blood supply to the heart muscle and prevents complications. Israel is considered one of the best countries for this operation, thanks to the experience of its surgeons, the use of advanced technology and the individual approach taken to every patient. If you have problems with your heart, do consult a cardiac surgeon and ask about the possibility of bypass grafting for the sake of your health and wellbeing.

fields.title: Arrhythmia
fields.bodyHtml:
Arrhythmia: advanced treatment in Israel

An arrhythmia is a disturbance of the rhythm of the heartbeat, which may show itself as a fast, slow or irregular heartbeat. In Israel, advanced medical technologies and methods are used to diagnose and treat arrhythmia, allowing patients to return to a normal rhythm of life.

Diagnosis of arrhythmia:

  1. Laboratory tests:
    Full blood count
  2. Electrocardiogram (ECG)
    The main method for determining the type of arrhythmia and its characteristics.
  3. Holter monitoring
    Continuous ECG monitoring over 24 hours or several days to detect episodic arrhythmias.
  4. Exercise testing (treadmill test)
    Helps assess the heart's response to physical exertion and reveal hidden rhythm disturbances.
  5. Electrophysiological study
    An invasive test that establishes precisely the mechanisms behind the arrhythmia and where in the heart it originates.

Methods of treating arrhythmia:

  1. Drug treatment:
    • Antiarrhythmic drugs: used to restore and maintain a normal heart rhythm.
    • Anticoagulant therapy: drugs that prevent blood clots forming, particularly important in atrial fibrillation.
  2. Cardioversion:
    • Electrical cardioversion: a procedure in which brief electrical discharges help restore a normal heart rhythm.
  3. Catheter ablation:
    • A minimally invasive procedure in which radiofrequency or cryogenic energy destroys the abnormal areas of heart tissue responsible for the arrhythmia.
  4. Implantation of pacemakers and defibrillators:
    • Pacemakers: devices that regulate the heart rhythm in slow arrhythmias.
    • Implantable cardioverter defibrillators (ICDs): devices that monitor and correct potentially life-threatening arrhythmias.

Advantages of treatment in Israel:

  • An individual approach: every patient is given a personal plan of diagnosis and treatment based on their particular medical needs.
  • A multidisciplinary team: cardiologists, arrhythmia specialists and cardiac surgeons work together to achieve the best results.
  • Access to advanced technologies and treatments: the use of the latest research and innovative medical equipment.
  • A high standard of medical care: Israeli clinics are known for their high level of patient care and the effectiveness of their treatment.

Treatment of arrhythmia in Israel is aimed not only at relieving symptoms but at minimising health risks in the long term, helping patients lead an active and healthy life.

fields.title: Arthritis
fields.bodyHtml:
Arthritis: comprehensive treatment in Israel

Arthritis covers a group of conditions marked by inflammation in one or more joints, leading to pain, swelling, stiffness and reduced function. In Israel patients have access to advanced methods of diagnosing and treating arthritis, including rheumatoid arthritis, osteoarthritis, psoriatic arthritis and other forms of the disease.

Diagnosis of arthritis

  1. Clinical examination
    Includes assessment of symptoms, medical history and the physical state of the joints.
  2. Laboratory tests
    Blood tests for markers of inflammation (C-reactive protein, erythrocyte sedimentation rate), for antibodies characteristic of rheumatoid arthritis (rheumatoid factor, anti-CCP) and other specific tests.
  3. Imaging
    • X-rays: help establish the stage of the disease and the presence of deformity and erosion.
    • MRI and ultrasound: used for more detailed imaging of the soft tissues, the synovial membrane, the cartilage and early erosion.
    • Arthroscopy: a minimally invasive procedure to assess the inside of the joint and obtain tissue samples for histological examination.

Methods of treating arthritis in Israel

  1. Drug treatment
    • Disease-modifying antirheumatic drugs to slow the progression of the disease.
    • Biological agents and JAK inhibitors to control the inflammatory process in rheumatoid arthritis.
    • Non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drugs (NSAIDs) to reduce pain and inflammation.
  2. Physiotherapy and rehabilitation
    Individual exercise programmes to maintain and improve joint function, reduce pain and prevent further damage.
  3. Diet and lifestyle
    Advice on nutrition and lifestyle changes aimed at reducing inflammation and improving general health.
  4. Surgical treatment
  5. Includes arthroscopic cleaning of the joint, synovectomy, osteotomy and joint replacement where damage is severe.

Advantages of treatment in Israel

  • A multidisciplinary approach
    A team of doctors including rheumatologists, orthopaedic surgeons and physiotherapists works together to draw up a comprehensive treatment plan.
  • Advanced treatments
    Access to the newest drug therapies and innovative surgical techniques.
  • An individual treatment plan
    Treatment is adapted to each patient's needs, taking account of symptoms, the stage of the disease and their way of life.
  • Comprehensive support and rehabilitation
    Extensive rehabilitation programmes help speed recovery and improve patients' quality of life.

Treatment of arthritis in Israel offers patients wide scope for controlling the disease effectively, reducing pain and inflammation, preventing further destruction of the joints and improving quality of life.
